text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Satsuki Sho approaching, 
Sakura Chiyono O received word from both 
Mejiro Ardan and Yaeno Muteki asking to 
decline running alongside each other as 
much as possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan made her resolve. Even if her 
legs shatter, she would seize a radiance 
all her own— one that rivals the brilliant 
light of her great sister, if only for a 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki reflected on how much her 
grandfather had supported her. Wanting to 
repay his kindness, she yearned for proof 
of her own growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O, however, has strong 
feelings of her own. Maruzensky was 
overwhelmingly strong. Yet, she couldn't 
run in the Derby back then. If so—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wanted to prove Maruzensky's strength 
by winning—as the one who admired her and 
was entrusted with her dream. ...She 
refused to lose, no matter what.
